title: gita.atla.in · Availability, Visitors, Traffic, AI & Security

panels.title: Status now
panels.description: Whether the latest run of the uptime check succeeded from every probe. Measured · Grafana Synthetic Monitoring check "${sm_job}".

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Share of check runs that succeeded over the selected range, across all probes. Measured · Grafana Synthetic Monitoring check "${sm_job}".

panels.title: Check duration
panels.description: Average time for one check run (DNS, connect, TLS, response) over the selected range. Measured · Grafana Synthetic Monitoring check "${sm_job}".

panels.title: Failed check runs
panels.description: Check runs that failed over the selected range, across all probes. Measured · Grafana Synthetic Monitoring check "${sm_job}".

panels.title: Page views
panels.description: Page loads recorded by the RUM script in visitors' browsers. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/RUM (us-east-1) · app monitor ${rum_app}. Browsers of real visitors only; most bots do not run JavaScript.

panels.title: Page load (p75)
panels.description: Navigation duration: from request until the page finished loading. 75% of page loads were at or below this. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/RUM (us-east-1) · app monitor ${rum_app}. Browsers of real visitors only; most bots do not run JavaScript.

panels.title: LCP (p75)
panels.description: Largest Contentful Paint: when the main content became visible. Good ≤ 2.5 s, poor > 4 s. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/RUM (us-east-1) · app monitor ${rum_app}. Browsers of real visitors only; most bots do not run JavaScript.

panels.title: CLS (p75)
panels.description: Cumulative Layout Shift: how much the page jumped while loading. Good ≤ 0.1, poor > 0.25. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/RUM (us-east-1) · app monitor ${rum_app}. Browsers of real visitors only; most bots do not run JavaScript.

panels.title: INP (p75)
panels.description: Interaction to Next Paint: delay between a click or tap and the page responding. Good ≤ 200 ms, poor > 500 ms. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/RUM (us-east-1) · app monitor ${rum_app}. Browsers of real visitors only; most bots do not run JavaScript.

panels.title: JavaScript errors
panels.description: Uncaught errors thrown in visitors' browsers. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/RUM (us-east-1) · app monitor ${rum_app}. Browsers of real visitors only; most bots do not run JavaScript.

panels.title: Page views and browser errors (hourly)
panels.description: Page views, JavaScript errors and failed requests made by the page, per hour. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/RUM (us-east-1) · app monitor ${rum_app}. Browsers of real visitors only; most bots do not run JavaScript.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests the load balancer received in the selected range. Includes bots. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/ApplicationELB (${region}) · load balancer ${alb}.

panels.title: App 4xx responses
panels.description: Requests the app answered with a 4xx status (bad input, not found). Measured · CloudWatch AWS/ApplicationELB (${region}) · load balancer ${alb}.

panels.title: App 5xx responses
panels.description: Requests the app answered with a 5xx status: the app failed. Should be 0. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/ApplicationELB (${region}) · load balancer ${alb}.

panels.title: Load balancer 5xx
panels.description: 5xx responses generated by the load balancer itself, usually because no healthy pod could answer (502/503/504). Should be 0. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/ApplicationELB (${region}) · load balancer ${alb}.

panels.title: Requests and server errors
panels.description: Requests and 5xx responses per 5 minutes. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/ApplicationELB (${region}) · load balancer ${alb}.

panels.title: App response time
panels.description: Time from the load balancer sending a request to the app until the response started. Answers call Bedrock several times, so seconds are expected. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/ApplicationELB (${region}) · load balancer ${alb}.

panels.title: LLM calls
panels.description: Converse calls to global.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0. One question makes several (rewrite, rerank, answer). Measured · CloudWatch AWS/Bedrock (${bedrock_region}) · calls made by the app.

panels.title: Embedding calls
panels.description: Calls to amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0, which turns each search query into a vector. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/Bedrock (${bedrock_region}) · calls made by the app.

panels.title: LLM input tokens
panels.description: Tokens sent to global.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0: prompts, retrieved verses and instructions. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/Bedrock (${bedrock_region}) · calls made by the app.

panels.title: LLM output tokens
panels.description: Tokens global.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0 generated. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/Bedrock (${bedrock_region}) · calls made by the app.

panels.title: LLM latency (p90)
panels.description: 90% of calls to global.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0 finished within this time. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/Bedrock (${bedrock_region}) · calls made by the app.

panels.title: Errors & throttles
panels.description: Client errors, server errors and throttled calls across all Bedrock models. Throttles mean a quota was hit. CloudWatch publishes these metrics only when one occurs, so "None recorded" means none in the selected range. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/Bedrock (${bedrock_region}) · calls made by the app.

panels.title: Calls per model (hourly)
panels.description: Bedrock invocations per hour, per model. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/Bedrock (${bedrock_region}) · calls made by the app.

panels.title: LLM tokens (hourly)
panels.description: Input and output tokens per hour for global.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/Bedrock (${bedrock_region}) · calls made by the app.

panels.title: Estimated Bedrock cost
panels.description: Tokens × the per-1K-token prices entered in the dashboard's price boxes (top of the page), prefilled from the AWS Price List for ap-south-1 (on-demand, 2026-09-26). An estimate: check AWS Billing for the actual charge. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/Bedrock (${bedrock_region}) · calls made by the app.

targets.expression: FILL(SUM(SEARCH('{AWS/Bedrock,ModelId} MetricName="InputTokenCount" ModelId="global.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0"', 'Sum', 3600)), 0) / 1000 * ${price_llm_in} + FILL(SUM(SEARCH('{AWS/Bedrock,ModelId} MetricName="OutputTokenCount" ModelId="global.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0"', 'Sum', 3600)), 0) / 1000 * ${price_llm_out} + FILL(SUM(SEARCH('{AWS/Bedrock,ModelId} MetricName="InputTokenCount" ModelId="amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0"', 'Sum', 3600)), 0) / 1000 * ${price_embed_in}
targets.label: Estimated cost

panels.title: Blocked by firewall
panels.description: Requests AWS WAF stopped before they reached the site, answered with 403. This is the firewall working, not the site failing. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (${waf_region}) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

panels.title: Allowed by firewall
panels.description: Requests WAF let through to the site. Includes bots the managed rules do not recognise. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (${waf_region}) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

panels.title: Share blocked
panels.description: Blocked ÷ (blocked + allowed) over the selected range. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (${waf_region}) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

panels.title: Allowed vs blocked (hourly)
panels.description: Requests per hour by WAF decision. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (${waf_region}) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

panels.title: Blocks by managed rule
panels.description: Which AWS managed rule matched blocked requests (for example path traversal, missing user agent, exploitable paths, bad IP reputation). Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (${waf_region}) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

panels.title: Blocked by country
panels.description: Countries the blocked requests came from, based on source IP. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (${waf_region}) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

panels.title: Allowed by country
panels.description: Countries of requests WAF allowed. Includes unrecognised bots, so it approximates, not measures, visitor location. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (${waf_region}) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

panels.title: Blocked by attack type
panels.description: WAF's classification of blocked requests. Measured · CloudWatch AWS/WAFV2 (${waf_region}) · web ACL ${waf_acl}.

options.content:
**Signal type:** Measured. Every panel's ⓘ names its source.

**Site:** `https://gita.atla.in/`. Gita RAG app: FastAPI on EKS (gita-rag-cluster) behind an Application Load Balancer, answering with Amazon Bedrock. Regional AWS WAF on the load balancer; no CloudFront.

**Availability:** Grafana Synthetic Monitoring check `gita.atla.in homepage`, every 5 minutes from 3 probes.

**Real visitors:** CloudWatch RUM app monitor `gita-atla-in` (no cookies, all sessions).

**Traffic:** CloudWatch `AWS/ApplicationELB` in `ap-south-1`, load balancer `app/k8s-gita-gitaapp-62bac50d1f/3f31a5493e811f77` (created by the Kubernetes ingress). Requests include bots.

**AI:** CloudWatch `AWS/Bedrock` in `ap-south-1`: answers from `global.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0`, search vectors from `amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0`. The cost panel multiplies tokens by the per-1K-token prices in the boxes at the top of the page (from the AWS Price List, 2026-09-26; update them if prices change).

**Security:** AWS WAF web ACL `gita-atla-in` (ap-south-1). Blocked requests return 403 and are also counted in the 4xx rate.

**Not shown:** pod CPU, memory and restarts (Container Insights is not enabled); deploy markers; request logs (not collected).
